sections.text:
-Target: all enemies. Ability Power 160. Success value 80. 5x magic damage (Dark).
Ability Power boosted by 10 for each increase in Skill level.
-Target: all enemies. Removes damage reflect, damage reduction, and continuous heal effects.
-Target: all enemies. Reduces healing received by 40% for 60 seconds.
-Target: all enemies. Reduces all stats by 50% for 60 seconds.
-Target: all allies. Recovers 25 Cost.
-Target: all allies. Increases Cost recovery speed by 10 for 60 seconds.
-Target: yourself. Applies frenzy (nullifies debuffs, nullifies status ailments, permits piercing through damage reduction and damage reflection) for 60 seconds.
-Applies Dazzle Collapse (Reduces attack Ability accuracy by 20%) to the enemy Field for 60 seconds.
Increases stats selected in stat slot 1 by 8000
Increases stats selected in stat slot 2 by 8000
